resources.string: Choose another default profile before deleting this one. At least one profile must remain.

%1$s\n\nMerge keeps destination settings, existing watch history for matching videos, and playback progress, combines playlists and groups with matching names, and skips duplicate entries. Replace clears the destination first. The source stays unchanged. Shared notes and device settings stay shared.
Replace the subscriptions, playlists, groups, saved searches, history, progress and study sessions in %1$s with copies from the source? This cannot be undone.
Profile data copied. The source is unchanged.
